text:
Iris: FYI FalconMetrics saw recurring tail latency on large-report exports this morning. Renewal check in 12 days. p95 spiking to ~7.2s on 11k-token jobs. Need a low-risk mitigation we can run before the renewal to show progress. :clipboard:
Ben: Oof. Model + route details?
Iris: They're on hosted `gptx-3-8b`, default routing, no quant. Pattern: nightly exports + some ad-hoc long interactive runs.
Sofia: Quick, low-risk tactics: (A) introduce a soft-int8 profile (weights int8, critical ops fp16) to reduce runtime cost with minimal quality drift; (B) route long/export jobs to a small dedicated compact pool; (C) enable prefix caching for repeated headers in exports. Combine all in a cautious canary.
Ben: Can we do targeted routing by token-count and a customer tag so only Falcon traffic hits it?
Sofia: Yes. Example rule: `if prompt_tokens >= 2048 AND customer=FalconMetrics -> dedicated-compact-softint8-usw2` else -> hosted-lowlatency.
Iris: Safety first. Propose quick eval and short canary:
1) Eval: 15 representative Falcon prompts (mix long exports + edge cases). Metrics: perplexity, stop-token drift, and 5 manual spot-checks. Target: perplexity delta <= 2% and no manual fails. ETA 60m.
2) Canary: 5% export traffic to dedicated pool for 2h with fallback.
Ben: Fallback conditions? Don't want mid-renewal blowups.
Sofia: Fallback: if cohort error-rate > 0.6% or p95 > 9s -> immediate reroute to hosted-default + abort canary. Also sample 30 responses to cs-audit/falcon/ for the renewal deck.
Iris: Who owns what? Ben (eval + quality signoff), Sofia (routing + quant profile), infra-bot (provision + monitor). I'll handle CS comms and renewal note.
infra-bot: Provisioning request queued (job: prov-4750). Dedicated pool ETA ~6m. Canary template: 5% for 2h.
Ben: Running eval now. Command: `./eval.sh --base=gptx-3-8b --alt=gptx-3-8b-soft-int8 --prompts=falcon_samples.json --metrics=perplexity,stop_drift` Will post artifacts link when done.
CS-bot: Created renewal note draft and attached canary plan: https://console.redwood/cs/notes/falcon/4750012345
infra-bot: Dedicated pool ready. Will deploy route rule: `if prompt_tokens >= 2048 && customer=FalconMetrics -> dedicated-compact-softint8-usw2`. Canary ready at 01:12 UTC.
Ben: Eval results (50m): perplexity +1.3% on soft-int8, spot-checks OK (0/5 fails). Within thresholds. Artifacts: https://console.redwood/cs/artifacts/falcon/4750012345
Sofia: Canary started. 5% export traffic -> dedicated-compact-softint8-usw2. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/obs/falcon/4750012345
infra-bot: Canary live. Health checks every 5m. Alerts on breach.
Sofia: Early telemetry (first 30m): canary cohort p95 down to ~2.1s vs baseline 7.2s. No automated quality alerts.
Iris: Great. I'll message the CSM and note we'll recommend staged rollout if stable for 24h. Capture customer feedback during the next sync.
Ben: I'll push eval artifacts + regression checklist to cs folder for audit.
Sofia: I'll keep fallback rule active and prepare escalation plan: 5% -> 30% (12h) -> 70% (24h) -> full, gated at each step.
Iris: Thanks team. This should give us a concrete improvement to show the customer before renewal. Will update after 24h. :raised_hands:
